```{r}
# merge algorithm benchmark results with current package scRhythmBayes baseline

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(Matrix)
  library(readr)
  library(tibble)
})

wrap24 <- function(x) {
  ((x %% 24) + 24) %% 24
}

# Step 1. Load simulated object
obj_master <- readRDS("/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/simulate_data_new2.rds")
DefaultAssay(obj_master) <- "RNA"

cs_master0 <- sum(GetAssayData(obj_master, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts"))

metadata <- obj_master@meta.data
metadata$cell <- rownames(metadata)

stopifnot(identical(colnames(obj_master), metadata$cell))

# Step 2. Add current package scRhythmBayes 27-seed result
res_phase_27 <- readRDS(
  "/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/Benchmark/benchmark_seed_number/res_phase/res_phase_seed27_rep1.rds"
)

res_phase_27 <- res_phase_27 %>%
  mutate(cell = as.character(cell))

idx_srb <- match(colnames(obj_master), res_phase_27$cell)
stopifnot(all(!is.na(idx_srb)))

obj_master$ZT_scRhythmBayes <- wrap24(res_phase_27$ZT_pred[idx_srb])
obj_master$Rbar <- res_phase_27$Rbar[idx_srb]
obj_master$r_cell <- res_phase_27$r_cell[idx_srb]

# Step 3. Add Tempo result
tempo_pred <- read.csv("/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/tempo_pred_phase_new.csv")

idx_tempo <- match(colnames(obj_master), tempo_pred$cell_id)
stopifnot(all(!is.na(idx_tempo)))

obj_master$ZT_tempo <- wrap24(tempo_pred$tempo_phase_mean_hour[idx_tempo])

# Step 4. Add CYCLOPS result
obj_cycl <- readRDS(
  "/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/obj_4ct_cyclops_new.rds"
)

meta_cycl <- obj_cycl@meta.data

idx_cyclops <- match(colnames(obj_master), meta_cycl$cell_id)
stopifnot(all(!is.na(idx_cyclops)))

obj_master$ZT_cyclops <- wrap24(meta_cycl$ZT_cyclops[idx_cyclops])

# Step 5. Add Cyclum result
cyclum_df <- read.csv("~/scRhythmBayes/data/cyclum_eval_merged_new.csv")

idx_cyclum <- match(colnames(obj_master), cyclum_df$cell_id)
stopifnot(all(!is.na(idx_cyclum)))

obj_master$ZT_cyclum <- wrap24(cyclum_df$cyclum_zt[idx_cyclum])

# Step 6. Check count matrix unchanged
cs_master1 <- sum(GetAssayData(obj_master, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts"))
stopifnot(cs_master0 == cs_master1)

# Step 7. Save merged object and metadata table
saveRDS(
  obj_master,
  "~/scRhythmBayes/data/obj_4ct_ALL_4algorithms_current_package_SRB.rds"
)

meta_export <- obj_master@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") %>%
  as.data.frame()

write_csv(
  meta_export,
  "~/scRhythmBayes/data/meta_data_algorithm_benchmark_current_package_SRB.csv"
)

head(meta_export)

colnames(meta_export)

# algorithm benchmark CDF plot using current package SRB result

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
})

wrap24 <- function(x) {
  ((x %% 24) + 24) %% 24
}

# Step 1. Load merged metadata
meta_df <- read_csv(
  "~/scRhythmBayes/data/meta_data_algorithm_benchmark_current_package_SRB.csv"
)

# Step 2. Set output path
out_dir <- "~/scRhythmBayes/data/Benchmark/algorithm_benchmark_current_package_SRB"
plot_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "plots_cell_phase")

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Step 3. Define algorithms and colors
method_vec <- c(
  "ZT_scRhythmBayes",
  "ZT_cyclops",
  "ZT_tempo",
  "ZT_cyclum"
)

method_label <- c(
  "ZT_scRhythmBayes" = "SRB",
  "ZT_cyclops" = "CP",
  "ZT_tempo" = "TP",
  "ZT_cyclum" = "CM"
)

method_cols <- c(
  "ZT_scRhythmBayes" = "#A8C7E6",
  "ZT_tempo" = "#F0918E",
  "ZT_cyclops" = "#D591B4",
  "ZT_cyclum" = "#DEBCD9"
)

# Step 4. Calculate AUC, MedAE, and raw CDF for each algorithm
auc_all <- list()
cdf_all <- list()

for (method_i in method_vec) {
  
  message("Processing method: ", method_i)
  
  true_h <- as.numeric(meta_df$t_true)
  pred_h <- as.numeric(meta_df[[method_i]])
  
  diff_h <- abs((pred_h - true_h) %% 24)
  err_h <- pmin(diff_h, 24 - diff_h)
  err_h <- sort(err_h)
  
  hrsoff <- c(0, err_h, 12)
  
  frac_wrong <- sapply(
    hrsoff,
    function(hrtol) {
      100 * sum(err_h > hrtol) / length(err_h)
    }
  )
  
  pct_correct <- 100 - frac_wrong
  
  norm_pct_correct <- pct_correct / 100
  norm_hrsoff <- hrsoff / 12
  
  auc <- sum(norm_pct_correct[-length(norm_pct_correct)] * diff(norm_hrsoff))
  medae <- median(err_h)
  
  auc_i <- tibble(
    method = method_i,
    method_label = method_label[method_i],
    AUC = auc,
    MedAE = medae,
    n_cell = length(err_h)
  )
  
  cdf_i <- tibble(
    method = method_i,
    method_label = method_label[method_i],
    threshold_h = hrsoff,
    pct_correct = pct_correct
  )
  
  auc_all[[method_i]] <- auc_i
  cdf_all[[method_i]] <- cdf_i
}

auc_all <- bind_rows(auc_all)
cdf_all <- bind_rows(cdf_all)

auc_all

write_csv(
  auc_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "algorithm_auc_medae_current_package_SRB.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  auc_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "algorithm_auc_medae_current_package_SRB.rds")
)

write_csv(
  cdf_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "algorithm_cdf_current_package_SRB.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  cdf_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "algorithm_cdf_current_package_SRB.rds")
)

# Step 5. Build CDF curves on fixed threshold grid
threshold_grid <- seq(0, 12, by = 0.05)

cdf_grid_all <- list()

for (method_i in method_vec) {
  
  true_h <- as.numeric(meta_df$t_true)
  pred_h <- as.numeric(meta_df[[method_i]])
  
  diff_h <- abs((pred_h - true_h) %% 24)
  err_h <- pmin(diff_h, 24 - diff_h)
  
  pct_correct <- sapply(
    threshold_grid,
    function(hrtol) {
      100 * sum(err_h <= hrtol) / length(err_h)
    }
  )
  
  cdf_grid_i <- tibble(
    method = method_i,
    method_label = method_label[method_i],
    threshold_h = threshold_grid,
    pct_correct = pct_correct
  )
  
  cdf_grid_all[[method_i]] <- cdf_grid_i
}

cdf_grid_all <- bind_rows(cdf_grid_all)

write_csv(
  cdf_grid_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "algorithm_cdf_grid_current_package_SRB.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  cdf_grid_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "algorithm_cdf_grid_current_package_SRB.rds")
)

# Step 6. Prepare legend labels
legend_labels <- c()

for (method_i in method_vec) {
  
  auc_i <- auc_all %>%
    filter(method == method_i)
  
  label_i <- paste0(
    method_label[method_i],
    ": ",
    sprintf("%.3f", auc_i$AUC),
    ", ",
    sprintf("%.3f", auc_i$MedAE)
  )
  
  legend_labels <- c(legend_labels, label_i)
}

legend_labels

# Step 7. Plot CDF as TIFF
tiff(
  filename = file.path(plot_dir, "algorithm_cell_phase_cdf_current_package_SRB.tiff"),
  width = 3.2,
  height = 3.2,
  units = "in",
  res = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)

par(
  family = "serif",
  mar = c(4, 4, 2.5, 1),
  mgp = c(2.1, 0.55, 0),
  tcl = -0.25,
  lwd = 0.5
)

plot(
  NA,
  xlim = c(-0.3, 12.5),
  ylim = c(-2, 102),
  xlab = "Correct to within (hrs)",
  ylab = paste0("% correct (N = ", nrow(meta_df), ")"),
  main = "Absolute error CDF",
  cex.main = 0.9,
  cex.lab = 0.8,
  cex.axis = 0.75,
  bty = "n"
)

box(lwd = 0.5)

abline(
  a = 0,
  b = 100 / 12,
  col = "lightgray",
  lwd = 0.7
)

for (method_i in c("ZT_cyclops", "ZT_tempo", "ZT_cyclum", "ZT_scRhythmBayes")) {
  
  cdf_i <- cdf_grid_all %>%
    filter(method == method_i)
  
  lines(
    cdf_i$threshold_h,
    cdf_i$pct_correct,
    col = method_cols[method_i],
    lwd = 1.2
  )
}

legend(
  "bottomright",
  legend = c("        AUC, MedAE", legend_labels),
  col = c(NA, method_cols[method_vec]),
  lwd = c(NA, rep(1.2, length(method_vec))),
  bty = "o",
  box.lwd = 0.3,
  cex = 0.62,
  y.intersp = 0.9
)

dev.off()

# Step 8. Plot CDF as PDF
pdf(
  file = file.path(plot_dir, "algorithm_cell_phase_cdf_current_package_SRB.pdf"),
  width = 3.2,
  height = 3.2
)

par(
  family = "serif",
  mar = c(4, 4, 2.5, 1),
  mgp = c(2.1, 0.55, 0),
  tcl = -0.25,
  lwd = 0.5
)

plot(
  NA,
  xlim = c(-0.3, 12.5),
  ylim = c(-2, 102),
  xlab = "Correct to within (hrs)",
  ylab = paste0("% correct (N = ", nrow(meta_df), ")"),
  main = "Absolute error CDF",
  cex.main = 0.9,
  cex.lab = 0.8,
  cex.axis = 0.75,
  bty = "n"
)

box(lwd = 0.5)

abline(
  a = 0,
  b = 100 / 12,
  col = "lightgray",
  lwd = 0.7
)

for (method_i in c("ZT_cyclops", "ZT_tempo", "ZT_cyclum", "ZT_scRhythmBayes")) {
  
  cdf_i <- cdf_grid_all %>%
    filter(method == method_i)
  
  lines(
    cdf_i$threshold_h,
    cdf_i$pct_correct,
    col = method_cols[method_i],
    lwd = 1.2
  )
}

legend(
  "bottomright",
  legend = c("        AUC, MedAE", legend_labels),
  col = c(NA, method_cols[method_vec]),
  lwd = c(NA, rep(1.2, length(method_vec))),
  bty = "o",
  box.lwd = 0.3,
  cex = 0.62,
  y.intersp = 0.9
)

dev.off()
```
